author: Navjot Tomer (Mindstellar)
description_html:
LocationIQ Geocoder

Finds the exact map position of a Shopclass listing from its street address, using LocationIQ. Distance search then uses that point instead of the city or region centre.

Requirements

  • Shopclass 7.0.0 or later
  • PHP 8.0 or later, with the curl extension
  • A LocationIQ access token (the free plan is enough to start)

It works on shared hosting. Nothing runs on a normal page load; the plugin is built only when an address is looked up.

Setup

  1. Install and activate the plugin, then open Plugins → LocationIQ Geocoder.
  2. Paste your access token into API key, pick the Region, and save.
  3. Open Settings → General → Maps and choose LocationIQ under Address lookup.

The saved key is never shown again. Leave the box blank to keep it.

When lookups run

A lookup runs from the job queue after a listing with a street address is saved, not while the visitor waits. Cron (or auto-cron) must be running; that is enough on shared hosting, and a queue worker makes it faster.

Limits

The free plan allows 2 requests a second and 5,000 a day. Answers are kept up to a year, so an address is looked up once.

The plugin waits for the next second when the free limit is reached. A server error or a refused key makes the lookup fail, and Shopclass tries again later. An address LocationIQ cannot find is remembered for a day.

Daily limit

Daily request limit (default 5,000, the free plan's allowance; 0 is no limit) counts lookups from midnight UTC. When it is used up, or LocationIQ answers with a rate limit (HTTP 429), the lookups stay queued and run again once the limit renews: the next day for the daily limit, a minute later for the per-second and per-minute ones. Nobody waits for them on the site. The settings page shows how many listings wait, and when lookups go on.

Older listings

Tick Older listings and save to look up every listing that has a street address and no map position yet. One background job queues them 50 at a time, within the daily limit. It needs Shopclass 7.0.0 or later.

Attribution

The free plan requires a visible link to LocationIQ wherever its data is shown. Print it in your theme with osc_geocode_attribution().

Uninstall

The plugin's settings are removed. If Address lookup in Settings → General → Maps named this plugin, it is reset to none.

Tests

./tests/run.sh

They need no network. Core is read from ../osclass, or from SHOPCLASS_CORE.

License

GPL-3.0-or-later.

versions.changelog_html:
Fixed

  • The settings page shows when an API key is saved.

New

  • Address lookup through LocationIQ for listings with a street address.
  • Settings for API key and region (us1 or eu1).
  • Answers are kept up to a year, so an address is looked up once.
  • Calls stay under the free plan's 2 requests a second.
  • A daily request limit (5,000 by default); when it or LocationIQ's own limit is used up, lookups wait in the queue until it renews.
  • Look up older listings with a street address from the settings page, in the background.
  • Translation template in languages/locationiq.pot.
